_about: Testimonials for stresslessaboutmoney.com. site.js renders ONLY entries with consent === true AND a non-empty firstName AND a non-empty quote. Anything else is skipped silently. The section that shows them stays hidden while this list is empty.

_schema.firstName: string, required — first name only, as the person agreed to be shown
_schema.quote: string, required — their words, unedited beyond trimming
_schema.context: string, optional — a few words after the name, e.g. 'teacher, Brooklyn' or 'Clarity Package'
_schema.consent: boolean, required — true only when the person has explicitly agreed to this quote appearing on the site with this name
_schema.consentDate: string, optional — ISO date the consent was given, e.g. 2026-09-01

_example.quote: This entry is documentation. It never renders because consent is false.
